verdict.rationale: Alma is a technology-enabled immigration law firm with an online client portal, so a natural-language or AI-assistant interface is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence only shows questionnaires on the portal, attorney strategy meetings, and an llms.txt file. llms.txt helps LLMs read the site; it does not let users operate the product through natural-language commands. No conversational or agentic interface is evidenced.
